title: Conductor unit report
description: The structured report every executor returns for one unit. Enforced with codex --output-schema and agy --json-schema.

status.description: done: every acceptance item met. partial: some met, work stopped. blocked: could not proceed.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths created or edited. Paths only.

acceptance.description: One entry per acceptance checklist item from the brief, in order.

output.description: Trimmed failure output only. Empty when passed.

blockers.description: What stopped the work, or what the orchestrator must decide. Empty when none.

notes.description: Anything the orchestrator needs to know that the diff does not show: assumptions, seams with other units, follow-ups. Short.
